name: HKDF-SHA-256 byte-domain specification
domain: Byte-oriented inputs accepted by the corresponding HMAC operations and output lengths from zero through 8160 bytes.
input_semantics: Optional salt, input keying material, and application context, with a caller-selected output length.
output_semantics: The extract step returns a 32-byte key. Expand writes exactly the buffer length on success.
preconditions: An imported pseudorandom key has at least 32 bytes.
Each HMAC input fits the available byte domain.
